name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight - Sho Minazuki in "Break Out Of... ATLUS Kitajoh Remix"
summary: Additional playable track 'Break Out Of... (ATLUS Kitajoh Remix)' with Sho Minazuki as main dancer. His costumes 'Winter Yaso Outfit', 'P4AU 2P Colors 1' and 'P4AU 2P Colors 2' are included. This item is compatible with both Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight on PS4.
